data.name: BroadcastMessage
data.shortDescription: BroadcastMessage syncs ingame chat with Discord, keeping communication unified across both platforms
data.description:
BroadcastMessage seamlessly integrates your in-game chat with a designated Discord channel. Send messages in-game, and they appear in Discord. Type in Discord, and your messages show up in the game's chat. Stay connected with your team no matter where you are!
###BroadcastMessage works on:
- Dedicated Server
- Multiplayer Hosts
- (Should Not Be Any Issues if you have it installed anyways)
###NOTE: Requires more than just a mod installation to work.
##### Follow This Guide: https://github.com/move123456789/SOTF-Mods/blob/master/README.md
Made by SmokyAce and ThirtyTwelve
